scope: Research-only Shampoo v1.4 method, four-case weight closure, 50-product candidate, and 10-product holdout-v3. The wider pre-existing dirty worktree was not treated as this delta.

verification.command: npm run research:shampoo:weight-v3:report && npm run research:shampoo:build-v14-candidate
npm run research:shampoo:validate-holdout-v3 && npm run research:shampoo:report-holdout-v3

review.counterpart: Claude Code read-only review completed; both hard findings were resolved and mechanical integrity findings were covered by tests.
review.workerExplorerUse: Independent formula raters, holdout labelers, a judgment adjudicator, a targeted OGX explorer, and a bounded integrity worker were used; the orchestrator integrated and reverified all results.
review.remainingRisk: INCI cannot reveal exact concentrations or finished-product deposition. Holdout focus defaults showed prevalence-sensitive kappa, so the raw labels and adjudication remain visible rather than being tuned to a target distribution.

stopBoundary: No catalog import, database write, product matching activation, production deployment, commit, push, or merge was performed.
